notes.title: Epic Update
notes.notes:
Zachypoo here, I worked on this update for a couple of hours, and here are the patch notes.



 House #2's Door is now a Boss Door lol.
 A Water Bucket is added.
 Ball Fart Death Dungeon now has another room.
 A couple of chests have been added.
 added some useful text about what level you need to be.
 Villagers no longer reset completely on death, they still get removed on death.

notes.notes:
Made all Villages have working shops

And some other things, idk lol.

Enjoy Banana Quest, sorry you bought this game lol.
